children.text: What is said over a page's frame on the canvas. It names the page and is pressed to select it and dragged to move it; everything else on it is either said elsewhere or covers the design. These keep the name, keep the breakpoint while a page has views, and move notes pinned to the page as a whole off its corner.

Name, route, size, breakpoint, and a note on the whole page pinned on the frame's corner. The route is a button that can be pressed or caught by a drag, the size repeats what the breakpoint and the inspector say, and the pin covers the page's own corner.

children.name: Variant · A · The name, and what is pinned to the page beside it

children.text: A · The name, and what is pinned to the page beside it

Only the name and the breakpoint stay. Notes and comments on the page as a whole leave its corner and become one mark after the name: the glyph of their kind and how many there are. Pressed, it opens the same card the pin opens today, under the mark. Notes on an element inside the page keep their pins. The route and the size are in the inspector, as they already are. Recommended.

children.name: The note, as its pin opens it today

children.text: Opening a route from the list keeps the map's zoom and the list's scroll where they were.

children.name: Variant · B · Notes at the far end

children.text: B · Notes at the far end

The same mark, at the header's right end, where an agent's label already goes while it works. The name has the whole line to itself, so it is cut later on a narrow frame. While an agent works, its label takes the end and the mark steps left of it.

children.name: Variant · C · The name alone; the notes on the selected page

children.text: C · The name alone; the notes on the selected page

Nothing on the canvas but the name and the breakpoint. A page's own notes are shown when the page is selected, as a button at the end of its controls in the element toolbar, and always in the Comments panel. The quietest canvas, but a page with notes looks like one without until it is selected.
At rest: no sign of the note
Selected: the note is in the toolbar below
The element toolbar while the page is selected

children.name: Variant · D · Views named by their breakpoint

children.text: D · Views named by their breakpoint

As A, and a view no longer repeats the page's name: the page's frame carries the name, each view beside it only its breakpoint. The breakpoint is the view's name, so it is pressed and dragged as the name is. A page without views shows its name alone, with no 'base'.
